name: audix-stock-audit
description: Audix Solutions & Co. — mobile-first stock audit web application

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
